newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp, KN Energy set Thur announcement.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp, KN Energy set Thur announcement.

text.p: PacifiCorp and KN Energy will make an announcement on Thursday at 0830 PDT in Portland, Ore., the companies said Wednesday.
PacifiCorp and KN Energy would not comment on the purpose of the news conference, but said in a release they "are simplifying life for consumers."
Officials at KN Energy could not be reached for comment.
PacifiCorp, based in Portland, serves 1.3 million electric customers in seven western states and is a major player in the wholesale power business.
KN Energy, based in Lakewood, Colo., is an integrated natural gas company.
CEOs of both firms will host the news conference.
